title: Dead code in the buy slice: getV3Price, the legacy single-chain safety helpers imported into bot.ts, and the third-party honeypot dispatch

evidence.note: getV3Price is defined and never called
checkTokenMetadata, isLiquidityLocked, simulateSwap, checkHoneypot, isBlacklistedToken, isLiquiditySufficient, isKnownBadToken, hasMaxWalletOrTxLimits are imported and never called in bot.ts
checkHoneypotForChain has no caller (removed from both banks per the comment at bot.ts:955-963), so honeypotIsCheck and goplusHoneypotCheck are unreachable

sibling_sites_checked: Call counts for every imported legacy helper in bot.ts were 0 (grep over the snapshot). simulateSell is RC-16 (AUD-BUY-007), checkHoneypot's key defect is AUD-BUY-012, pairDiscovery is SC-20 (AUD-BUY-024).
severity_rationale: S4 hygiene: unreachable code that still reads like live safety logic and keeps legacy CONFIG paths importable.
recommendation: Delete the unreachable functions and imports (no behaviour change). Phase 29.
